enrolment_grant_one_open.name: enrolment_grant_one_open
enrolment_grant_one_open.where: "app"."enrolment_grant"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "app"."enrolment_grant"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "app"."enrolment_grant"."session_id" IS NOT NULL

entity_tombstone_check.name: entity_tombstone_check
entity_tombstone_check.value: ("entity"."purged_at" IS NULL) = ("entity"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "entity"."type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "entity"."tax_classification" IS NOT NULL)

invitation_operator_shape_check.name: invitation_operator_shape_check
invitation_operator_shape_check.value: "invitation"."issued_via" = 'owner' OR ("invitation"."entity_id" IS NULL AND "invitation"."inviter_user_id" IS NULL AND "invitation"."role" = 'viewer')

invitation_accepted_claimed_check.name: invitation_accepted_claimed_check
invitation_accepted_claimed_check.value: "invitation"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "invitation"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL
